messages:
sasha: quick follow-up from the fairness sync — proposing a "token stewardship" handshake between ingress, quota, and abuse-detector to make burst signals actionable without leaking PII or full payloads
pranav: curious — what does the handshake surface? lightweight headers or a sidecar event stream?
elaine: +1 to keeping it lightweight. headers for fast path, sampled event stream for richer signals (latency, tokens, prompt-hash)
tom: concern: headers can be spoofed unless signed. we should include an HMAC over a small canonical payload. ops-bot: rule: header size <= 1KB to avoid perf regressions
sasha: agreed. sketch: X-Token-Stewardship: lease=abc123;epoch=42;sig=BASE64_HMAC. ingress attaches after auth; quota service verifies sig before honoring lease
pranav: for samples, abuse-detector needs context to score bursts. propose a sampled event (async) with fields: tenant_id, lease, epoch, token_count_bucket, short_prompt_hash. sampling rate configurable per-tenant
elaine: config example:

```yaml
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.01
  high_risk_tenants:
    - tenant: t-legacy
      rate: 0.2
```

elaine: and event payload shape (minimal): {"lease":"abc123","epoch":42,"tokens":256,"prompt_hash":"sha1"}

sasha: tradeoffs: header-only approach -> super low latency, but less signal for false-positive reduction. sampled-stream -> higher fidelity, but eventual consistency and more infra cost
tom: on interface boundaries: quota service should expose two APIs: 1) Check/Consume(token_count, stewardship_header) sync 2) EmitSample(event) async. Keep verification logic centralized in quota to avoid duplication
pranav: abuse scoring: avoid tenant-identifiable content. use prompt_hash + coarse token windows. if score > threshold, quota returns penalty hint in response: penalty=delay_ms or penalty=deny. ingress applies soft-shed, then escalates to full deny if repeated
elaine: we need metrics: stewardship_verification_failures, sampled_event_rate, score_latency, penalty_applied_count per-tenant. OSS dashboards and alerting rules
sasha: rollout plan: 1) implement header HMAC + sync check with harmless default (no penalties) 2) enable sampled events to abuse-detector in opt-in tenants 3) enable penalty hints via feature-flag for internal traffic 4) GA
pranav: backward compat: unknown headers -> treat as no-lease. tenants on legacy path get legacy quotas. document the header format and rotation policy for signing keys
tom: security note: signing keys in KMS, rotate quarterly. add a replay window field in header (ts + nonce) to prevent replay attacks
elaine: open question: how do we surface false-positive feedback? short-term: manual review + ticketing. long-term: feedback loop from app-level telemetry to adjust sampling weights and scoring models
sasha: small spike task for next week: prototype header HMAC across ingress -> quota verify -> emit sample. who volunteers?
pranav: I can pick up the quota side verification and API changes
tom: I'll do the ingress bits and key rotation integration
elaine: i'll wire up sampled-event pipeline and a basic scorer and dashboard
sasha: thanks — will post a short RFC appendix with header grammar, sample payloads, and rollout checklist. :thumbsup:
